description: Create brands from token documents or a six-value recipe. Use it when adding a brand; use brand_apply to edit an existing brand or tokens_build to compile current sources. Returns templates, validation reports, recipes with provenance/gaps, or created brands and build results. action selects template, validate, derive, create, draft, show or apply. draft reads a local DTCG file with token names and light/dark modes; show reviews slot evidence and fallbacks; apply with draftId and accept:true validates and creates the reviewed brand. derive accepts exactly one of tokens, css or cssPath; review gaps before creating. create validates every theme, refuses replacement, writes into your brands folder and builds tokens. Template and validation calls write nothing. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#brand_create; full schema: oods://schemas/brand_create.input.json.

action.description: 'derive' reads your own tokens or shadcn theme CSS into a partial recipe with provenance and gaps, writing nothing; 'template' returns the documents to fill: every slot of the light (base), dark and high-contrast (hc)… See full schema for details.

brand_id.description: The id the brand will have. Actions: validate, create (required), draft (required). See full schema for details.

css.description: A shadcn theme CSS entry, in place of tokens. Actions: derive. See full schema for details.

cssPath.description: Absolute path to the shadcn theme CSS entry, in place of tokens or css. Read only. Actions: derive.

documents.description: The filled template: one plain design-token document per theme, brand-relative (surface.canvas, not color.brand.<id>.surface.canvas), each slot {"$type": "color", "$value": "<CSS colour>"}. Actions: validate, create.

from.description: Where the starting values come from: an existing brand (default A), optionally with one of the shipped presets over it; or a recipe, which gives the complete brand, graded. Actions: template, draft.

brand.description: An existing brand whose values the template starts from. Default: A.

preset.description: A shipped preset id whose values go over the brand's; every template response lists the… See full schema for details.

hints.description: Exact dot-separated token paths, or CSS custom property names, that override inference. Invalid hints produce gaps, never silent fallback. Actions: derive.

recipe.description: A brand recipe in place of documents: the brand it gives is checked, and for create written, like filled documents. Actions: validate, create.

modes.description: modes. Fields: base, dark. See full schema.

tokens.description: A DTCG document with your own token names. Group $type is inherited; {group.token} aliases resolve inside the document. Actions: derive.
